test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully and decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.

**Statement:**

Of all the ice creams brands manufactured in India, ‘Amulya’ brand has the highest sales since last five years. The sales of other ice cream brands fluctuate every year.

**Conclusions:**

I. The taste of ‘Amulya’ ice creams is popular among Indian residents.

II. The sales of all other Indian brands of ice creams are known.

options.text: Neither conclusions I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Given,

Statement: Of all the ice creams brands manufactured in India, ‘Amulya’ brand has the highest sales since last five years. The sales of other ice cream brands fluctuate every year.

Conclusions:

I. **The taste of ‘Amulya’ ice creams is popular among Indian residents.**

 
• The statement mentions that Amulya has the highest sales for the past five years.
 
• High sales could be due to multiple factors such as marketing or distribution.
 
• Conclusion I is an assumption regarding taste that is not directly supported by the statement.
 
• Therefore, this conclusion does not logically follow.

**II. The sales of all other Indian brands of ice creams are known.**

 
• The statement mentions that the sales of other ice cream brands fluctuate every year.
 
• This indicates that there is data available regarding the sales of the other brands, for it to be known that they fluctuate.
 
• Therefore, it can be inferred that the sales of all other Indian brands of ice creams are known.

So, Only conclusion II follows..

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
